text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You're strong-willed, hate losing, and are an honor student of an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...And then—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I don't want to acknowledge you.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Watching it makes me all restless inside.
Like a sizzle burning right from the tips of my ears!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Your eyes are special.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Not a speck of dirt suits those
sparkling eyes of yours."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Full of confidence.
Those eyes, always looking upward.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Those eyes, so earnest and fitting for someone at
the center of the story...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I'm terrified.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "I'm the protagonist too!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm the protagonist who has overcome all the ups and downs together with you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I did special training with Vodka-chan and Cesario-chan! I trained with Triple Tiara Umamusume to attain a special way of running!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
At the Kikuka Sho! And at the Takarazuka Kinen!!
We put on some thrilling races, didn't we?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Don't you go surpassing me so easily...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I will beat you...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —I'm definitely gonna win!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Remember it! My "trajectory"!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If this were a story, there'd definitely be a hint in there!!
A hint to defeat my rival!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I got my hands on it at the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!
A special move that won't lose to anyone's late kick!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If that finishing move won't win it for you,
then evolve it into a super finishing move!
Train hard and master a new technique!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Because that's how the protagonist wins!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even if you're like the protagonist of some story!
I'm still gonna be the one who wins!

While watching Kiseki shout toward the setting sun,
I organize the data for the Japan Cup.
choice_data_list: (Kiseki will get through this predicament too.)

text_block_list.text: ...Kiseki is the main character.

She will definitely come up with a new strategy.
An entertaining one, worthy of defeating a formidable opponent.

"So even without her asking, I know.
When formulating a strategy for Kiseki,
what we need next is—"

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, Trainer <username>!
I was able to confirm that matter you asked about the other day.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—A practice race right now,
focused primarily on Leaders and Betweens...!?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I thought you might need it around now.
Yeah, I figured you'd be needing it soon.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, thank you! 
It's almost taking shape!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: My super special move is--!!

"And that night.
She came."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I've put together a proposed strategy.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I believe these are the only two ways
to beat Almond-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Only these two types of "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes. The first one is—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "Why is Kiseki-chan picking up the pace?!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"What... What is happening here?!
Just when it seemed like a normal pace up until the halfway mark—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"If I just run the fastest from start to finish,
no one will ever catch me, right?"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"What a... What an incredible time!
It's a record! A new world record has been set!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The first is the royal road of the front-runner style.
Winning through final acceleration as well—a 'front-runner embodying the absolute strongest.'

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
............
The other one is――

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Kiseki makes her move!
Pulling away from the pack by 6 lengths! No, a 7-length lead!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "With an extreme runaway lead, Kiseki suddenly opens a 10-length gap! Can he maintain this lead!?"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"However! Can the chasers reach them?! Will they make it?!
Or will Kiseki pull off the wire-to-wire win?!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAHHH!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The other is 'runaway front-runner.'

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Trusting in everything I've built up—my speed, my stamina, my sense of pace... I'm betting everything on myself.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Both of these strategies are ideal.
You might think it's impossible, though."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Still, I know I can do it.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Because I'm a horse girl who takes on challenges,
and one who inspires hope for the future."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Above all else, because this heart of mine is burning!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Running through the pouring rain as a child,
I still believe that I can become the main character!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even in the Japan Cup!
From here on out, too! I believe I can be the main character!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Because I'm the one
who's gonna paint a thrill no one has ever seen before...!!"
choice_data_list: (A story of yours that no one's ever seen—)
(A story of yours that no one's ever seen—)

text_block_list.text: ...My throat is rumbling.

Whether it's a "Runaway Front-Runner" or "Late-Stage Accelerating Front-Runner"...
Pulling off either in the Japan Cup—would make you a legend.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ......Which one excited you more, Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As my reader,
which challenge would excite you more!?

I can feel the fire burning deep within Kiseki.
Having stood by her side and enjoyed her unique charm all this time, I know—!
choice_data_list: I want to see the ultimate front-runner who keeps accelerating!
I want to see a runaway lead!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll make it the best race ever
and get everyone super excited...!!

Kiseki's feelings come through to me loud and clear.
I clench my fists even tighter.

Kiseki has resolved to win.
We made a pledge together.
—Carrying the ultimate strategy to seize victory in our hearts.
